summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a regular quarterly dividend declaration. On July 16, 2026, the board declared a $0.10 per share dividend on common stock, payable September 14, 2026 to holders of record August 31, 2026. The filing includes routine cautionary language about future dividends. No special-situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, activism, restructuring, or spin-off—is disclosed. The dividend is ordinary and within the company's normal course of business as a REIT. No structural changes, strategic reviews, or unusual capital actions are present. This is a routine current report with no special-situation content.
